HOW IT WORKS

One agreement.
Two clear sides.

Trade Bridge gives both parties a structured way to define the exchange, add the detail that matters, and agree on the path before they move ahead.

  1. 01

    Start or join a trade

    Create a new agreement or enter a trade code shared by the other party.

    →
  2. 02

    Add both sides of the agreement

    Each party records what they are sending, with a description, value, and supporting photos.

    →
  3. 03

    Choose handling, insurance, and expert review

    Select setup support and record the protections or evaluation your agreement requires.

    →
  4. 04

    Both parties review and agree

    Each party sees the same summary and confirms the defined terms.

    →
  5. 05

    AGREEMENT READY

    Proceed with a clear record

    Use the agreed terms and service options to coordinate the next steps for your trade.

    →

TRADE TYPES

From freight to transfer.

Set up the terms for physical goods, approved digital value, and digital goods — with a workflow that reflects each category.

01

Physical goods

Equipment, valuables, stock, collectables, materials, and more. Physical cash is not accepted.

02

Machinery & equipment

Document dimensions, handling needs, collection points, and delivery requirements.

03

Art & collectibles

Record condition, provenance notes, photography, and optional expert evaluation.

04

Digital goods

Software, licences, files, accounts, domains, creative assets, and digital services.

05

Software & licences

Record the specific entitlement, transfer terms, and relevant platform restrictions.

06

Bank transfers

Approved digital-value transfer method with timing dependent on bank confirmation.

07

Digital wallets

Document an approved wallet transfer route. No physical cash trades.

08

Cryptocurrency

Network conditions and confirmation requirements affect the proposed timing.

09

NFTs

Record the asset and transfer context; confirmation timing depends on the chain.

10

Specialist trades

For unusual, fragile, high-value, or difficult-to-classify agreements.

SECURITY & EXPERT REVIEW

Clarity before
confidence.

Every agreement is built around shared visibility: two sides, one version of the terms, and clear handling choices from the start.

Trade Bridge is a workspace for defining the agreement. Service availability and eligibility are confirmed for each trade.

01

Agreement visibility

Both parties use the same view of the terms being proposed.

02

Trade-code access

Trade codes provide a simple route into a shared agreement.

03

Both-party review

Every side has a clear view of what is being exchanged before the agreement is confirmed.

04

Human-assisted review

Optional guided setup is recorded in the agreement summary.

05

Expert evaluation

Specialist or high-value categories can be flagged for evaluation.

06

Item documentation

Descriptions and photos give both sides a shared record of the terms being discussed.

07

Service confirmation

Handling, insurance, and specialist requirements are shown clearly before the trade progresses.
